lines.t: Oh, delicate heart,
Rising to face another day,
Questioning every step you take,
Wondering if you chose the proper way.
You bear the weight as daylight ends,
And carry it to bed again.
Sleep, sleep, sleepless nights,
Tossing and turning, no rest in sight.
Anxiety grips your fearful heart,
And the weight settles in with the dark.
Every choice feels harder to make,
Wondering which road you should take.
Facing this life as if on your own—
Sleep, sleep, sleepless nights.
Oh, delicate heart,
Bearing this path alone,
Trying to discern the way
While feeling far from home.
Laying every burden at His feet,
Longing for His guidance and the peace you seek.
Sleep, sleep, sleepless nights,
Tossing and turning, no rest in sight.
Anxiety grips your fearful heart,
And the weight settles in with the dark.
Every choice feels harder to make,
Wondering which road you should take.
Facing this life as if on your own—
Sleep, sleep, sleepless nights.
Oh, delicate heart,
Aching through the sleepless night,
You may not see His guiding hand
Or understand His will tonight.
Though unseen, your every step to Him is known,
And you have never walked alone.
Proverbs 3:
Trust in the Lord with all your heart,
And lean not on your own understanding;
In all your ways acknowledge Him,
And He shall direct your paths.
